source.title: Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，進入強化學習，本週內向 Bot 用戶軟推出

figure.quote_en: Training (aka pre-training) is done. Lot of cleanup was needed on the SFT data to get that mostly right. Now, 4.8 is in RL and the evals are starting to climb. We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes.
